== Tune Identifier Legend ==

{| class="wikitable" style="text-align:left;"
! CODE !! MEANING !! ALTERNATIVES
|-
| KANES || Tuner's name || —
|-
| - || Separator || —
|-
| XX || Header Optim. || 41 = 4-1 Head., 42 = 4-2-1 Head., TB = Turbo
|-
| XX || Catalyst || CE = Catalyst Enabled, CD = Catalyst Disabled
|-
| X || Camshaft || S = Stock, G = Ghost Cams, C = Upgraded Cams
|-
| X || Pops & Bangs || S = Stock, P = Pops Enabled
|-
| X || IACV Tuning || S = Stock, I = IACV Tuned
|-
| X || Fuel Optim. || 95 = 95 RON, 98 = 98 RON, 10 = 100 RON
|-
| X || Launch Control || D = LC Disabled, L = LC Enabled
|}

== Example Breakdown ==

'''Identifier:''' <code>KANES-42CDGPI98L</code>

* '''KANES''' → Owner's name
* '''42''' → 4-2-1 headers
* '''CD''' → Catalyst Disabled
* '''G''' → Ghost Cams Enabled
* '''P''' → Pops & Bangs Enabled
* '''I''' → IACV Tuned
* '''98''' → Optimized for 98 RON
* '''L''' → Launch Control Enabled
